name: neck-tiger-tail
instructions:
1. While in a seated position, position the tiger tail at the base of the neck with one hand on either handle.
2. Adjust pressure into neck by applying more or less force through the hands.
3. Slowly roll up and down the length of one side of the neck for 20-30 seconds.
4. Repeat on the other side.
starting_position: 1. While in a seated position, position the tiger tail at the base of the neck with one hand on either handle. 2. Adjust pressure into neck by applying more or less force through the hands.
